Which categories of federal award are most numerous: contracts, grants, loans or direct payments?
SELECT category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who ran for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania in 2024?
SELECT DISTINCT cand_name, cand_pty_affiliation FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'S' AND cand_office_st = 'PA' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which dosage forms are most common among approved drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average commercial electricity rate across U.S. ZIP codes?
SELECT avg(try_cast(comm_rate AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates
Which counties are split among the most congressional districts?

SELECT r.namelsad_county_20 AS county, s.usps AS state, count(DISTINCT r.geoid_cd119_20) AS districts FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 r JOIN govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_state s ON s.geoid = substr(r.geoid_county_20, 1, 2) WHERE try_cast(r.arealand_part AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many bioassays does PubChem hold?
Which Apple insiders have filed the most trading reports?

SELECT o.rptownername, max(o.rptowner_title) AS title, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner o ON o.accession_number = s.accession_number WHERE s.issuertradingsymbol = 'AAPL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest real-time price for 10-minute spinning reserves in eastern New York in 2022?
Nyiso As Prices Real Time 5 Min Rtasp
SELECT max(try_cast(east_10_min_spinning_reserve_mwhr AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_as_prices_real_time_5_min_rtasp WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which fuels power the most units in EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT primary_fuel_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did utility-scale solar generation grow from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.SUN-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY 1
Which states filed the most returns with incomes of $200,000 or more for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS returns FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE cast(agi_stub AS varchar) = '6' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were total reported greenhouse gas emissions, in tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission WHERE year = '2022'
Which New York counties had the highest average unemployment rate in 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS county, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'F' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND a.area_text LIKE '%, NY' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M13' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many listed drug products are Schedule II controlled substances?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE dea_schedule = 'CII'
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the deadliest single crash of 2022 by number killed?
SELECT statename, cityname, monthname, try_cast(fatals AS integer) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
Which New York counties have the largest land area?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties WHERE usps = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of drinking water violations are classed as major?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN is_major_viol_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_major_viol_ind IS NOT NULL
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEMBL activity results reach a pChEMBL value of 9 or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE pchembl_value >= 9
Which utilities have the most rate schedules in the Utility Rate Database?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE utility IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections of Texas law are recorded as repealed?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'tx' AND act_status = 'repealed'
Where in Texas are one-bedroom fair market rents lowest?
SELECT countyname, min(try_cast(fmr1 AS double)) AS one_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many insider reports filed in 2021 were amendments to earlier Form 4s?
SELECT count(*) AS amendments FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE document_type = '4/A' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2021'
Under what light conditions did most fatal crashes happen in 2022?
SELECT lgt_condname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent cases were filed in the Eastern District of Texas in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE court_name = 'Eastern District of Texas' AND substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'
Which states have built the most solar photovoltaic generating capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS solar_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Solar Photovoltaic' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did wind or hydro supply more of New York's power in 2023?

SELECT fuel_category, round(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / 12) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category IN ('Wind', 'Hydro') AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states record the most hazardous waste violations?
SELECT activity_location, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_violations WHERE activity_location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NRC event reports were declared an Alert or a more serious emergency?
SELECT count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications WHERE emergency_class IN ('ALERT', 'SITE AREA EMERGENCY', 'GENERAL EMERGENCY')
Which states have the most hospices enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_hospice_enrollments WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications build on a provisional application filed earlier?
SELECT count(DISTINCT application_number) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 WHERE continuation_type = 'PRO'
Organisations in which states receive the most sub-award dollars?

SELECT sub_legal_entity_state_name, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE sub_legal_entity_state_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility rate schedules come with net metering rules?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE dgrules = 'Net Metering'
Which states added the most wind capacity in 2021?
SELECT t_state, sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Form 4 reports did Tesla insiders file in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE issuertradingsymbol = 'TSLA' AND document_type = '4' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2022'
Which countries do inventors on U.S. patent applications come from most often?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports have cybersecurity in the title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%cybersecurity%'
Which states spent the most on energy in 2023?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS million_dollars FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCV.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
What did the Department of Defense buy most in Hawaii in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'HI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many citation links between opinions does the archive map?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.citation_map
Which counties in Florida have the oldest median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US12%' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is aspirin's CAS registry number?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2244' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Which states had the most fatal crashes in work zones in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(wrk_zone AS integer) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of closed Texas rate filings were withdrawn by the insurer?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN closed_type = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE status = 'Closed'
Which hospitals reported the most beds in their fiscal 2023 cost reports?

SELECT a.itm_alphnmrc_itm_txt AS hospital, max(try_cast(n.itm_val_num AS double)) AS beds FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc AS n JOIN govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_alpha AS a ON a.rpt_rec_num = n.rpt_rec_num AND a.wksht_cd = 'S200001' AND a.line_num = '00300' AND a.clmn_num = '00100' WHERE n.wksht_cd = 'S300001' AND n.line_num = '01400' AND n.clmn_num = '00200' AND cast(n.hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the average energy of the aspirin frames in revised MD17?
SELECT avg(energy_kcal_mol) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.rmd17_frames WHERE molecule = 'aspirin'
Which companies have issued the most medical device recalls?
SELECT recalling_firm, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE recalling_firm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average price of bananas per pound at the end of 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_pound FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000711211' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which major industry groups employed the most workers in December 2024?

SELECT i.industry_name, d.value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_ce_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_ce_industry i ON i.industry_code = s.industry_code WHERE s.data_type_code = '01' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND i.display_level = '2' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY try_cast(d.value AS double) DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds were confirmed active against HIV in the screening set?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv WHERE activity = 'CA'
Which states drew the most NIH research dollars in 2021?
SELECT org_state, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which companies received the most federal contract money for work in Alaska in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'AK' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of approved federal information collections gather personal information?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(piiflag = 'Yes') / count_if(piiflag IN ('Yes', 'No')), 1) AS pct_with_personal_info FROM govblock_executive.oira_pra_inventory
Which statutes are cited most often as the cause of action in federal dockets?
SELECT cause, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE cause IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total value of insiders' open-market stock purchases in 2023?
SELECT sum(try_cast(trans_shares AS double) * try_cast(trans_pricepershare AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_nonderiv_trans WHERE trans_code = 'P' AND trans_date LIKE '%-2023'
Which EPA enforcement cases carried the largest assessed penalties?
SELECT case_name, try_cast(total_penalty_assessed_amt AS double) AS penalty FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much carbon dioxide did power plants in New York emit in 2021?
SELECT sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'NY' AND year(date) = 2021
Which diseases are mentioned in the most chemistry patents?

SELECT e.corrected_text AS disease, count(DISTINCT l.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_locations AS l JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_entities AS e ON cast(e.id AS varchar) = cast(l.entity_id AS varchar) JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_types AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(e.type_id AS varchar) WHERE t.type_name = 'Disease' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the GDP of Harris County, Texas, in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(_2023 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE geofips = '48201' AND linecode = '1'
Which states have the most natural gas combined-cycle capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS gas_cc_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology LIKE 'Natural Gas Fired Combined Cycle%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies based outside the United States file financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba <> 'US'
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many power plants on the national map are listed as retired?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'RE'
Which states are home to the most generator owners?
SELECT owner_state, count(DISTINCT owner_name) AS owners FROM govblock_energy.eia860_owner_y_sheet_ownership GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was per capita personal income in Manhattan in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '36061' AND linecode = '3'
Which ATC anatomical groups contain the most drugs?
SELECT level1_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_atc_classification WHERE level1_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the number of NIH projects changed from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT fy, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE try_cast(fy AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have the most providers enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT state_cd, count(DISTINCT npi) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a gallon of whole milk cost on average in December 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000709112' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which trial judges' rulings are appealed most often?
SELECT ordering_judge_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE ordering_judge_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical subject heading is attached to PubChem compound 2244?
SELECT c1 AS mesh_heading FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh WHERE c0 = '2244' LIMIT 10
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most in New York?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many offshore wells on the outer continental shelf are permanently abandoned?
Hifld Ocs Oil And Natural Gas Wells
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_ocs_oil_and_natural_gas_wells WHERE replace(status, '"', '') = 'PA'
Which companies hold ownership shares in the most generators?
SELECT owner_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_owner_y_sheet_ownership GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Where do New York hospital patients go after they are discharged?
SELECT patient_disposition, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which technology classes hold the most published patent applications?

SELECT c.cpc_subclass, t.title, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_cpc_current c LEFT JOIN (SELECT cpc_subclass, max(cpc_subclass_title) AS title FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_cpc_title GROUP BY 1) t ON t.cpc_subclass = c.cpc_subclass WHERE c.cpc_sequence = '0' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical specialties received the most industry money in 2021?

SELECT covered_recipient_specialty_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which active banks hold the most assets?
SELECT name, try_cast(asset AS double) AS assets_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which states had the lowest per capita income in 1950?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y1950 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_sainc1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
Which California cities are home to the most NIH grants?
SELECT org_city, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states use the most energy per person?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS million_btu_per_person FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETPB.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of records make up the Zenodo physics and chemistry collection?
SELECT resource_type_general, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
